title: Portrayal lab (v1) - library devices placed in one rack, and the links between them
description: A LAB IS A RACK ELEVATION PLUS A LINK LIST. It lives at labs/<name>/lab.yaml, names library devices by their `name`, and names ports by placement id; nothing about geometry lives here, because a viewer resolves port positions from the compiled drawings. The build checks every placement (L132-L136) and writes each one to labs.json with its position resolved: the absolute rack unit, the face and the host. Rack units count the way the rack counts, U1 at the bottom, and a placement's `ru` is the lowest unit it takes.

name.description: the lab's id, by convention its directory

title.description: the heading a viewer shows; omitted means `name`

provenance.description: where each part of the lab came from, one sentence per topic - the layout, the topology, what was assumed

rack.description: the frame. A viewer may read keys beyond these two, so others are allowed

height-ru.description: rack units in the frame; omitted means 42. Every placement fits inside it (L135)

rails-only.description: draw the rails without a cabinet round them

devices.description: the placements, one per device in the rack

links.description: the cables. Each end is [placement id, port id] or [placement id, port id, strand]

placement.description: ONE DEVICE IN THE RACK. A `rack` device is placed by `ru`. A `rack-face` part - one that bolts to the rail face over a rack unit it shares, docs/cable-managers-design.md section 6 - is placed on a host (`on`, with `unit`) or at a rack unit (`ru`), never both, and says which `face`. `face`, `on` and `unit` are for rack-face parts only (L133).

id.description: unique in the lab (L132); `on` and every link end name a placement by it

cfg.description: which of the device's configurations; omitted means its default (L132)

ru.description: the lowest rack unit the device takes, U1 at the bottom of the rack (L135)

face.description: rack-face parts only: the rail face it bolts to. Omitted means front. On the rear it is behind the rear rails and turned round

on.description: rack-face parts only: the id of the rack device it sits in front of (or behind), so that it moves with that device (L132, L134)

unit.description: rack-face parts placed `on` a host only: which of the host's rack units, counted the way the rack counts - 1 is the host's bottom unit. Omitted means 1. Several parts on one tall host are several placements with different `unit` values (L134)

turned.description: the device is racked back to front: its other panel faces out of the face it is mounted to

span.description: a name for the run, so a viewer can colour spans apart
